boundary: This is exact review/reconstruction evidence, not a hermetic toolchain image. Maven, JDK, Python and other dependency caches, compiled binaries, settings and credential material are omitted. Their sealed identities remain in the original manifests where recorded. OS, dynamic-library, shell and standard-library limits in the original tooling/results remain applicable. Packaging executes no proof gate and does not turn a focused or failed result into repository-wide admission.
